description: Bulk color import via /api/colors returns a generic 500 Internal Server Error for every row. No validationErrors in the response.
resolution: The colorCategory codelist field was being sent as a plain string. Codelist fields must be sent as {code, name, version} objects. Rebuilt the payload with the object shape and the import succeeded.

summary: Colors list shows 'No records found' after successful import
description: Import reported success and the DB has the rows, but the Colors list page shows No records found.
resolution: The OpenSearch index for the color module did not exist, so the API returned index_not_found_exception. This is a backend infrastructure issue, not a data problem. Provisioned the missing index and records appeared.

summary: Care Instruction creation rejected - image required
description: Creating a Care Instruction via API fails saying image is required, but we don't have an image for it.
resolution: The image field is mandatory even when no real image is needed. Supplied a placeholder image id and the record saved.

summary: Approve button not visible for reviewer
description: A user who should approve supplier records cannot see the Approve button on the record.
resolution: The user was not a member of the approval user group referenced by the approval template. Added the user to the correct group and the Approve action appeared.

summary: Dropdown empty on the item form
description: A category dropdown on the item creation form is completely empty for all users.
resolution: The corresponding Code List had no entries. Populated the Code List and the dropdown values appeared. Every dropdown draws from a Code List.
